books.title: Depremde Hayatta Kalma
books.subtitle: Türkiye ve İstanbul İçin Görsel Deprem Hazırlık, Güvenlik ve İlk İyileşme Rehberi
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Depremde Hayatta Kalma, Türkiye’ye ve özellikle İstanbul’un yoğun apartman yaşamına göre tasarlanmış 120 adımlı görsel bir deprem hazırlık ve hayatta kalma sistemidir. Kitap, depremi korku görüntüleriyle değil, doğru kararları doğru zamanda verebilmek için anlaşılması gereken bir süreç olarak ele alır. İlk bölümlerde fay kırılması, sismik dalgalar, büyüklük–şiddet–yer hareketi ayrımı, Türkiye’nin tektonik bağlamı, Marmara, tehlike ile risk arasındaki fark, yerel zemin, büyütme, sıvılaşma, yamaç tehlikeleri ve kıyıda koşula bağlı tsunami riski açıklanır. Harita ve şemaların adres bazlı teşhis ya da deprem tahmini olmadığı özellikle korunur.

Hazırlık bölümleri ev içindeki yapısal olmayan tehlikeleri azaltma, oda oda güvenlik taraması, ağır eşyaları sabitleme, gaz–elektrik–su güvenliği sınırları, profesyonel yapı değerlendirmesinin rolü, aile iletişim planı, buluşma noktaları, e-Devlet ve resmî bilgi kanalları, afet çantası, su–gıda–ilaç–belge sürekliliği, çocuklar, yaşlılar, engelli bireyler, okul, işyeri ve apartman yönetimi gibi konuları bir araya getirir. İstanbul’a özgü sahnelerde apartmanlar, iki yakalı kent yapısı, toplu taşıma, Marmara kıyısı ve günlük hareketlilik yalnızca öğretici olduğunda kullanılır; amaç turistik bir İstanbul görüntüsü değil, gerçek karar ortamını görselleştirmektir.

Sarsıntı anı ve sonrasındaki sayfalar Çök–Kapan–Tutun davranışını, yatakta, yüksek binada, okulda, işyerinde, kamusal alanda, sokakta ve araçta ne yapılacağını; sarsıntı bittikten sonra yaralanma ve tehlike kontrolünü, artçı sarsıntıları, güvenli tahliyeyi, kıyı ve yamaç risklerini, 112’nin doğru kullanımını, mahsur kalma durumunda sinyal vermeyi, iletişim ağı yoğunluğunu, toplanma alanını, yanlış bilgiden kaçınmayı ve ilk 24–72 saati ele alır. Son bölüm yeniden giriş, hasar belgeleme, profesyonel değerlendirme, temel psikososyal sınırlar ve erken iyileşmeyi kapsar. Kitabın yaklaşımı nettir: depremi zamanlamak mümkün değildir; ancak ortamı, planı ve davranışı önceden hazırlamak mümkündür.
books.seo_description: Türkiye ve özellikle İstanbul için 120 adımlı görsel deprem rehberi: risk ve zemin bilgisi, ev hazırlığı, Çök–Kapan–Tutun, aile planı, 72 saat, ulaşım, tsunami, tahliye, 112 ve erken iyileşme.

books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: AI Trading Agents & AI Trading Bots treats an AI trading system as a governed workflow rather than a model attached directly to execution. It follows the path from evidence and market state through models, policy, abstention and independent risk to order-state reconciliation, portfolio constraints, testing, production architecture, security, graded autonomy and five end-to-end builds. The final sections study failure chains, backtest overfitting, uncertainty and controlled deployment, supported by implementation templates, checklists and incident dossiers.
books.seo_description: A practical engineering guide to AI trading agents and bots covering data pipelines, decision engines, risk, execution, testing, production architecture, security, autonomy, five end-to-end builds and failure discipline.

books.title: AI Prompts for Small Business Owners
books.subtitle: A Copy-and-Adapt Prompt Library for Strategy, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Customer Experience, Finance, and Growth
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
AI Prompts for Small Business Owners is designed to make generative AI useful inside the constraints of a real small business. Instead of asking what AI can do in the abstract, the book starts with the decision or work product that needs to improve, then fills prompts with concrete business context, evidence, constraints, risk and a named human decision owner. It repeatedly separates facts, assumptions and estimates and treats missing information as something to expose rather than silently invent.

The prompt library spans connecting AI to the business, business models and priorities, customer and demand evidence, marketing and local visibility, sales, operations, customer experience, finance and growth. Reusable templates include auditability, version ownership, sensitive-data removal, human review and measurable next steps. Legal, tax, accounting, employment, privacy and other consequential decisions are explicitly kept under professional and human responsibility rather than delegated to the model.
books.seo_description: A practical prompt library for small business owners covering strategy, customer evidence, marketing, sales, operations, customer experience, finance and growth with human review, privacy and decision-quality guardrails.

books.title: E-Ticaret Satıcıları İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları
books.subtitle: Mağaza, Ürün, Müşteri, İçerik, Karar ve Operasyon İçin Kopyala-Uyarla Yapay Zekâ Promptları
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
E-Ticaret Satıcıları İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları, mağaza, iş modeli, ürün veya kategori, hedef, hedef kitle, kanal, mevcut veri ve kısıtları aynı çalışma bağlamında toplar. Promptlar önce kritik bilgi açığını bulur; eksik bilgi kararın yönünü değiştirecekse bunu açıkça işaretler ve en fazla birkaç yüksek değerli soru ile bağlamı tamamlar. Amaç, güçlü görünen fakat yanlış varsayıma dayanan çıktıları azaltmaktır.

Kitap doğrudan kullanılabilir ve taranabilir çıktılarda yalnızca doğrulanmış ürün ve mağaza gerçeklerini kullanmayı, bilinmeyen güncel platform kuralı, ücret, pazar büyüklüğü veya performans sonucunu uydurmamayı ister. Her önerinin hangi kanıta dayandığını veya nasıl test edileceğini görünür kılar ve AI çıktısını nihai karar yerine bir sonraki insan kararını kolaylaştıran çalışma malzemesi olarak konumlandırır.
books.seo_description: E-ticaret satıcıları için mağaza bağlamı, ürün ve kategori, hedef kitle, kanal, veri, içerik, karar desteği ve operasyon süreçlerine yönelik doğrulanabilir yapay zekâ promptları.

books.title: Instagram ve TikTok İçerik Üreticileri İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları
books.subtitle: Kısa Video, Kişisel Marka, İzleyici, Hikâye, İçerik Fikri ve Uygulama İçin Kopyala-Uyarla Prompt Kütüphanesi
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Instagram ve TikTok İçerik Üreticileri İçin Yapay Zekâ Promptları, kısa format üretimini yalnızca daha çok metin yazdırma işi olarak görmez. Promptlar; kişisel marka sesini tanımlama, izleyicinin gerçek dilini ve ihtiyacını anlama, kısa video akışı kurma, sıradan bir olayı anlamlı hikâyeye dönüştürme, arama niyeti için içerik tasarlama ve takipçi sorularının arkasındaki gerçek ihtiyacı teşhis etme gibi görevleri bağlama duyarlı hâle getirir.

Kitap, içeriğin yapay görünmesini azaltmak için kısa ve konuşulabilir cümleleri, somut örnekleri, doğal Türkçeyi ve kişiselleştirilebilir değişkenleri öne çıkarır. Uydurma kişisel deneyim, doğrulanmamış algoritma genellemesi, boş vaat ve gereksiz clickbait'ten kaçınır; platform değiştiğinde metni körlemesine kopyalamak yerine tempo, açılış ve görsel dil değişkenlerini yeniden tanımlamayı teşvik eder.
books.seo_description: Instagram ve TikTok üreticileri için kişisel marka sesi, izleyici dili, kısa video, hikâye, arama niyeti, içerik fikirleri, revizyon ve özgünlük odaklı yapay zekâ promptları.

Shorts ayrı bir araçtır; kitabın odağı bütün kanal mimarisidir.

books.title: AI Prompts for Social Media Marketing
books.subtitle: A Copy-and-Customize Prompt Library for Strategy, Content, Campaigns, Engagement & Conversion
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
AI Prompts for Social Media Marketing is built as a decision system rather than a list of writing tricks. Its 297 reusable prompts connect business goals, audience evidence, channel roles, resources, brand constraints and measurement before asking AI to create content. The book avoids claims about hidden platform algorithms and guaranteed reach, followers, leads or sales, and it requires human review for accuracy, brand fit, legal and rights considerations and changing platform conditions.

The library moves from AI foundations and strategy into audience insight, personas, content, campaigns, engagement, community, conversion, testing, critique, reporting and workflow design. Prompts make assumptions visible, use evidence from customer questions, comments, interviews and performance data, and encourage explicit tradeoffs when resources are limited. The final master prompts help turn separate tasks into a maintainable social-media operating system.
books.seo_description: A 297-prompt social media marketing system for strategy, audience research, content, campaigns, engagement, community, conversion, critique, reporting and workflows with evidence and human review.

books.title: Ethics in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
books.subtitle: Human Responsibility on the Road to Artificial General Intelligence and the New Boundaries of Right and Wrong
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Ethics in the Age of Artificial Intelligence examines how the boundaries of right and wrong must be reconsidered as AI systems increasingly shape everyday life, education, work, relationships, public decision-making, and access to opportunity. Rather than treating ethics as an abstract philosophical layer added after deployment, the book frames responsibility, privacy, algorithmic bias, surveillance, manipulation, deepfakes, explainability, uncertainty, and human oversight as practical design and governance questions.

The book also moves toward more advanced questions involving autonomous systems and agents, the road toward artificial general intelligence, machine consciousness, and the possibility of future machine rights, while preserving a central question throughout: where should authority, accountability, and final responsibility remain with human beings? AI in education, the transformation of work and skills, parenting, algorithmic matching, digital intimacy, and technology-mediated relationships are examined within the same ethical framework.

Its approach is neither alarmist nor celebratory. The emphasis is on preserving human agency, accountability, dignity, and deliberate oversight while distinguishing what technology can do from what it should be allowed to do. The result is a practical ethical framework for readers who want to understand not only the capabilities of modern AI, but also the social and human responsibilities created by those capabilities.
books.seo_description: A practical guide to AI ethics covering responsibility, privacy, algorithmic bias, surveillance, deepfakes, manipulation, explainability, cognitive rights, education, work, relationships, autonomous agents and AGI.

books.title: Build and Publish Apps with Claude Code
books.subtitle: A Practical Guide to Creating Websites, Mobile Apps, App Store Projects, and Shopify Experiences
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Build and Publish Apps with Claude Code is a practical progression from fast AI-assisted website creation to micro web apps, subscription-ready and production-ready mobile applications, app-store publishing, and maintainable Shopify experiences. Rather than treating AI development as a one-prompt shortcut, the book teaches structured iteration: define the job, reduce ambiguity, build in phases, test each change, and move forward only when the current layer is stable. Early chapters cover website structure, branding, contact features, case studies, social proof, SEO, micro-app idea selection, build briefs, launch systems, mobile UI planning, API-key protection, real-device testing, debugging, persistence, authentication, security, and submission readiness.

The later app workflow develops a layered production sequence from interface and core feature through storage, identity, social systems, progression, and monetization, with practical examples using tools such as Expo, Supabase, AI model integrations, and Stripe. books.title: Claude AI for Small Business

books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Claude AI for Small Business reframes AI from a chat window into a reviewable operating system for a small business. Its central question is which repetitive tasks can be prepared, organized, analyzed, or drafted by Claude inside existing workflows while the owner remains responsible for approvals, customer relationships, and consequential decisions. The book begins with an AI command center built around workspace organization, approval rules, connectors, and reusable prompts, then moves through idea generation and market validation before applying the same operating discipline to finance, marketing, sales, support, legal and HR preparation, and day-to-day operations.

The practical model is deliberately cautious: Claude prepares; the owner approves. Financial work is reviewed rather than blindly automated, marketing emphasizes taste and consistency rather than volume, sales automation uses real context instead of invented personalization, and customer-support workflows preserve human authority over refunds, credits, replacements, and legal admissions. Legal and HR sections position AI as preparation rather than legal authority, while the operations chapter turns proven workflows into reusable skills, digital SOPs, and scheduled tasks. Implementation checklists, chapter prompt sets, and a 48-hour implementation plan are designed to help a solopreneur automate one department at a time instead of creating a fragile web of uncontrolled automation.
books.seo_description: A practical Claude AI guide for solopreneurs to build reviewable workflows for marketing, finance, sales, customer support, HR, legal preparation, operations, connectors, scheduled tasks, and reusable prompts.

books.title: Make Money with Claude AI
books.subtitle: The Practical Guide
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Make Money with Claude AI: The Practical Guide presents seven practical routes for turning Claude-assisted work into products or services: freelance writing and content services, digital products, a one-person AI-powered content agency, SaaS products, prompt packs, teaching and AI consulting, and broader client services. The book distinguishes active income from product or recurring models and repeatedly makes the same point: AI is a multiplier, not the source of value by itself. The commercial value comes from solving a real problem, applying human judgment, checking facts, adapting the output to a specific audience, and delivering a finished result that is useful enough for someone to pay for.

Each method is developed as a workflow rather than a motivational slogan. Freelance services start with one focused offer and a professional portfolio; digital products begin with a narrow buyer problem; agency work packages outcomes instead of raw content volume; the SaaS chapter starts with evidence of demand and recurring customer complaints before building; prompt packs are designed for a specific professional audience and must be tested before sale; consulting depends on understanding Claude well enough to integrate it into real work; and the client-acquisition chapter addresses positioning, outreach, pricing, and payment. Ready-to-use prompts are included throughout. The final recommendation is to choose one method, build the workflow, take a concrete first step, and improve based on results rather than trying every income path at once.
books.seo_description: A practical guide to earning with Claude AI through freelance services, digital products, content agencies, SaaS, prompt packs, consulting, client acquisition, and ready-to-use workflows while keeping human judgment central.

books.summary: Claude Fable 5.1 & Mythos 5.1: The Frontier Agent Playbook treats frontier models as components inside an engineered operating system rather than as magical chatbots. Production chapters address caching, batching, cost per completed task, observability, evaluation, safeguards, approvals, and an independent verifier. books.title: JEV AND SYSTEM ONE AI
books.subtitle: Building Fast, Calibrated, Decision-Native Software Beyond Generative LLMs
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
JEV AND SYSTEM ONE AI examines a different way to place machine intelligence inside production software: not as a conversational destination that must generate prose, but as a fast, typed, probabilistic decision component. Using Jev and TypeSafe AI's System One framing as a case study, the book asks what changes when software needs a route, score, probability, gate, category, or bounded judgment rather than an essay. Its central architectural idea is compositional: deterministic code handles what is exact, decision models handle bounded semantic ambiguity, generative models handle language and open-ended reasoning, and people remain responsible for novelty, accountability, and high-consequence judgment.

The book develops this idea from first principles through state design, semantic yes/no decisions, closed choice spaces, ordered scoring, parallel fan-out, calibration, confidence-gated automation, learned if-statements, model/tool/agent routing, guardrails, verification, retrieval, customer-service workflows, production architecture, observability, security, privacy, adversarial state, cost, throughput, governance, and human review. It also distinguishes probability from confidence, explains why type safety removes invalid output shapes without eliminating semantic error, and treats calibration, thresholds, fallback policies, evaluation sets, and operational traces as core engineering artifacts rather than optional afterthoughts.

The treatment is deliberately skeptical of hype. The manuscript separates company claims from independently established facts, explicitly notes that Jev's internal architecture and training corpus are undisclosed, and emphasizes that fast or schema-valid decisions can still be wrong, drift over time, or be inappropriate for reasoning-heavy tasks. Later chapters move beyond Jev itself to the broader System One AI stack: typed probabilistic intelligence as a reusable software primitive, domain-specific decision layers, multimodal judgment, adaptive routing, production question design, data engineering, migration from LLM-only systems, capacity planning, governance, and a practical 30-day adoption roadmap. The result is an engineering-oriented guide to decision-native AI as infrastructure rather than chat.
books.seo_description: An engineering guide to Jev, System One AI and decision-native software: typed probabilistic outputs, calibration, routing, guardrails, observability, evaluation, cost, governance and production architecture beyond LLM-only systems.

books.title: Money Follows Money:
books.subtitle: If You Want to Make Money, Give Other People Tools to Make It
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Money Follows Money is a practical business-building framework centered on economic value rather than wealth promises. The title does not mean that money magically attracts money; it means that businesses move closer to purchase decisions when they solve problems tied to revenue, cost, time, risk, error, or productive capacity. The book teaches readers to identify expensive recurring problems, understand the buyer before building, turn complaints into market clues, sell reduced friction, test manually before automating, validate a sale before overbuilding, measure what happens after purchase, and convert customer success into product knowledge. Later chapters develop entry, core, and professional products, useful free offers, evidence-based expertise, searchable content, systems, pricing, trust, productization, ecosystems, reinvestment, and a final value-machine loop linking problem, tool, customer action, result, proof, trust, distribution, learning, and a better tool.
books.seo_description: A practical business guide to finding expensive problems, building useful tools, validating demand, proving customer value, pricing, systems, trust, productization and sustainable growth.

books.title: Art as a Ladder to the Soul
books.subtitle: How Creativity, Beauty, Silence, and Witness Awaken the Inner Life
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Art as a Ladder to the Soul argues that creativity is not merely decoration, achievement, or entertainment but one of the forms through which a person can regain contact with an inner life thinned by speed, usefulness, performance, and constant visibility. It begins with inward fatigue, distance from one's own center, and the difference between art as escape and art as return. The book then explores why the soul needs art, creation before achievement, the forgotten language of feeling, music, drawing, writing, movement, beginnerhood, solitude, silence, beauty, numbness, and the artist as witness. Its concern is not professional artistry but the human capacity to feel, shape, witness, and offer what life is doing within. Distinct practices include listening, sketching, journaling, freewriting, movement, private dance, breath, unskilled creation, solitude, beautiful attention, thawing numbness, and ethical witness. The final movement asks the reader to protect hidden work, practice before mood, let beauty guide daily life, remain a beginner, witness what must not be lost, and carry the ladder into ordinary life.
books.seo_description: A deep practical meditation on creativity, music, drawing, writing, movement, beginnerhood, solitude, beauty, numbness, witness, and using art to return to presence and inner life.

books.title: Decision Trees in Machine Learning and Data Science
books.subtitle: A Visual Infographic Guide from Entropy and Gini to Python, Pruning, and Interpretable AI
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Decision Trees in Machine Learning and Data Science is a 136-page visual learning system that turns one of machine learning’s most interpretable model families into a sequence of diagrams, formulas, worked examples, code panels, projects, warnings, interview questions, and quick-reference pages. It begins with the core intuition that a decision tree is a learned hierarchy of useful questions. From there, the reader moves through supervised-learning context, classification versus regression, interpretability and limitations, then into the anatomy of roots, internal nodes, branches, leaves, decision paths, thresholds, depth, and binary or multi-way splits.

The mathematical core explains how a tree decides where to split. Impurity, entropy, information gain, Gini impurity, weighted impurity, regression error measures, and split selection are developed visually before the book moves into recursive partitioning, greedy learning, ID3, C4.5, CART, stopping criteria, overfitting, bias–variance trade-offs, validation, class imbalance, sample weighting, leakage, and pruning. Cost-complexity pruning and model control are treated not as optional cleanup but as part of the discipline required to keep a tree useful beyond the training data.

The final third converts the theory into practice with Python and scikit-learn workflows for classifiers and regressors, encoding, visualization, metrics, model inspection, and GridSearchCV. Real-world projects span classic and applied problems such as Play Tennis, Titanic survival, churn, credit decisions, car evaluation, heart-disease examples, factory scenarios, weather, and house prices, with educational and ethical cautions where the domain requires them. Interview questions, common mistakes, formula references, a visual glossary, and a final concept map connect the entire journey from data to questions, splits, impurity, algorithms, pruning, Python, projects, interpretation, and interpretable AI.
books.seo_description: A 136-page visual guide to decision trees covering tree anatomy, entropy, Gini impurity, information gain, CART, ID3, C4.5, pruning, scikit-learn, real-world projects, interviews, and interpretable AI.

books.title: SQL for Data Analysis
books.subtitle: A Visual, Practical Guide with Real Business Projects, Interview Problems, CTEs, Window Functions, Dashboards, and Portfolio Workflows
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
SQL for Data Analysis is a large visual, practice-oriented journey from the first relational concepts to advanced analytical work and portfolio delivery. Its learning architecture spans eighteen parts and treats SQL as more than syntax: the reader learns how data is structured, how table grain affects meaning, how databases and schemas are designed, how analysts work inside SQL tools and workspaces, and how command families, CRUD operations, data types, table creation, imports, exports, constraints, keys, NULL behavior, DDL, DML, and transactions fit into a reliable analytical workflow.

The central analysis sections develop clean SELECT queries, filtering, Boolean logic, sorting, date work, aggregation, GROUP BY, HAVING, descriptive statistics, joins, set operators, multi-table analysis, functions, CASE expressions, and data cleaning before moving into reusable logic with subqueries, CTEs, views, and temporary structures. Window functions receive a dedicated advanced section covering partitions, ordering, frames, ranking, running metrics, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, PERCENT_RANK, CUME_DIST, ROW_NUMBER, and related analytical patterns while preserving row-level detail. Throughout the book, examples use realistic sample tables, show query-to-output relationships, identify common traps, and distinguish business meaning from implementation detail.

A defining feature of the book is its dialect-aware and safety-aware approach. Portable principles are separated from engine-specific behavior across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and GoogleSQL for BigQuery when syntax or semantics differ. Destructive operations are treated with preview, validation, transaction, and rollback discipline rather than casual copy-and-run instructions. The final sections turn knowledge into performance through SQL interview patterns, structured problem solving, real business questions, optimization, dashboard-oriented thinking, portfolio projects, and a thirty-day practice and career-delivery plan. The result is a visual reference for learning to query, validate, interpret, and apply data—not merely memorize commands.
books.seo_description: A comprehensive visual SQL guide spanning relational foundations, schema design, SELECT, joins, aggregation, CTEs, window functions, dialect differences, interviews, business projects, optimization, dashboards, and portfolio delivery.

books.title: Earthquake Survival in California
books.subtitle: A Complete 120-Page Visual Guide to Earthquake Preparedness, Safety & Recovery
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Earthquake Survival in California is a 120-step visual preparedness, protective-action, and early-recovery system built specifically for California residents and visitors. It begins with earthquake science and local risk literacy—faults, shaking, ground failure, liquefaction, landslides, tsunami, buildings, and the correct use of hazard maps—while repeatedly separating hazard from a prediction of damage at a specific address. California geography, housing, coasts, freeways, Bay Area and Southern California contexts are used only when they change the decision, so the book remains a practical safety guide rather than a collection of landmarks or generic disaster posters.

The preparation sections move room by room and household by household. Readers learn how to reduce nonstructural hazards, distinguish what can be secured personally from what requires qualified structural assessment, protect important documents, build a home inventory, understand the general earthquake-insurance coverage gap, prepare a portable go-bag and stay-at-home supplies, plan water and food, maintain medications and medical devices, organize sanitation, prepare for power outages, and build family and accessibility-aware plans. Current California warning channels—including MyShake, Android Earthquake Alerts, Wireless Emergency Alerts, and the broader ShakeAlert ecosystem—are placed inside the larger rule that a warning is a cue for protective action, not a prediction tool.

The action and recovery sections cover Drop, Cover, and Hold On; bedrooms, high-rises, schools, workplaces, stores, outdoor spaces, freeways and other transportation contexts; coastal tsunami natural warnings; aftershocks; injury and household checks; fire, gas and electrical hazards; evacuation; communications; first 24–72-hour needs; damage documentation; cautious re-entry; professional assessment; and early recovery. The final master-reference pages compress the system into memorable before, during, after, 72-hour and recovery decisions. The book’s underlying message is practical rather than alarmist: uncertainty cannot be eliminated, but rehearsed decisions, safer spaces, reliable information, and prepared supplies can create better choices when time is short.
books.seo_description: A California-specific 120-page visual earthquake guide covering local hazard literacy, home preparation, Drop Cover Hold On, ShakeAlert/MyShake warnings, tsunami safety, 72-hour supplies, utilities, insurance, transportation, and recovery.

books.title: Por qué las personas inteligentes toman malas decisiones financieras
books.subtitle: La psicología oculta de ganar, gastar, ahorrar, asumir riesgos y crear riqueza
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Por qué las personas inteligentes toman malas decisiones financieras estudia la distancia entre saber qué decisión parece sensata y ser capaz de tomarla cuando intervienen la historia familiar, la identidad, el miedo, el estatus, el cansancio, el hábito, el presente y la incertidumbre. El libro comienza con las primeras lecciones de dinero y el libro de cuentas familiar que nadie escribió; después analiza compras emocionales y de estatus, la normalización de un nivel de gasto mayor, la relación con el yo futuro, el coste de oportunidad, el ahorro automático y la tensión entre voluntad y diseño del entorno. Más adelante pasa a la psicología de ganar más: habilidades con valor de mercado, confianza basada en pruebas, negociación y palancas. La parte de riesgo distingue una buena decisión de un buen resultado, trata la deuda como contrato antes que emoción y propone construir una vida capaz de soportar errores. El cuaderno del lector y el laboratorio de decisiones convierten las ideas en experimentos y casos hipotéticos.
books.seo_description: Guía práctica de psicología financiera sobre creencias heredadas, gasto emocional, estatus, yo futuro, ahorro, ingresos, deuda, riesgo, libertad financiera y mejores decisiones con dinero.

books.title: The High-Income FDE
books.subtitle: A Visual Guide to the High-Paying World of Forward Deployed Engineers, Their Workflows, Enterprise AI Deployments, and How They Operate in the Field
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
The High-Income FDE is a combined visual operating system and deep-dive text companion for understanding Forward Deployed Engineering as the discipline of turning general technical capability into a specific, trusted, repeatable customer outcome. The visual volume maps the role through deployment loops, discovery, integration, architecture, governance, adoption, economics, handoff and productization; the independent text companion then explains the mechanisms, trade-offs, failure conditions, operating decisions and career implications in depth.

The book treats the last mile as an engineering problem rather than a final installation step. It distinguishes installed, used, trusted and expanded deployments; defines the FDE as a builder, diplomat, operator and signal carrier; and shows how discovery changes architecture, architecture changes evaluation, evaluation changes autonomy, operability changes trust, trust changes adoption, adoption changes economics, and economics determines what should become reusable product. Later chapters cover integration risk, data and identity contracts, AI placement, deterministic versus probabilistic work, evaluation, security, observability, incident response, adoption, change management, cost and value, handoff, scaling the deployment organization, interview judgment, portfolio evidence, compensation and career sustainability, and the future of AI FDEs. Practical appendices provide qualification, discovery, success-plan, production-readiness, incident, adoption and handoff tools.
books.seo_description: A comprehensive visual and text field guide to Forward Deployed Engineering, enterprise AI deployment, customer discovery, architecture, security, evals, adoption, economics, handoff, productization, interviews and career leverage.

books.title: España ante el calor
books.subtitle: Guía visual para una vivienda fresca, saludable y eficiente
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.category: Hogar, clima y calidad del aire
books.summary:
España ante el calor es una guía visual de 100 páginas concebida específicamente para viviendas, climas y rutinas de España. No es una traducción literal de una guía internacional: reconstruye la lógica térmica y de calidad del aire con terminología de España, unidades métricas, euros cuando son necesarios, pisos, áticos, patios, balcones, persianas, toldos y situaciones reales de vivienda. El recorrido parte de una idea sencilla pero decisiva: la casa funciona como un sistema térmico. El calor entra, se genera, se almacena, se desplaza y debe salir; por eso comprender radiación, conducción, convección, inercia térmica, humedad, movimiento del aire, noches tropicales, isla de calor urbana y microclima permite elegir mejor antes de gastar dinero en una solución.

La parte práctica enseña a construir el perfil térmico de la vivienda y a leer orientación, recorrido solar, ventanas, vidrio, cubierta, fachadas, aislamiento, puentes térmicos, infiltraciones, distribución interior y fuentes de calor. A partir de ese diagnóstico se desarrolla una estrategia por capas: primero controlar la ganancia solar con sombra exterior, toldos, persianas, cortinas, películas solares, superficies adecuadas y soluciones compatibles con viviendas de alquiler; después decidir cuándo abrir o cerrar, cómo aprovechar ventilación cruzada, ventilación nocturna, ventiladores, deshumidificación, refrigeración por zonas y aire acondicionado sin convertir una regla útil en una receta universal. El libro rota deliberadamente entre calor seco del interior, calor extremo andaluz, humedad mediterránea, humedad atlántica y noches muy cálidas.

La guía también integra un problema que a menudo se separa del calor: la calidad del aire. Explica cómo decidir entre ventilar para refrescar o cerrar frente a contaminación, PM2,5, PM10, calima, polvo sahariano o humo de incendios; aborda purificadores, caudal de aire limpio, una habitación prioritaria de aire limpio, CO₂ como pista de ventilación y el efecto de cocinar sobre partículas, humedad y temperatura. Las últimas páginas conectan confort, factura eléctrica, demanda de refrigeración, mantenimiento, cortes de suministro y planificación diaria. El objetivo no es imponer una temperatura o un aparato, sino dar al lector un sistema visual para observar su vivienda, comparar condiciones y tomar decisiones más frescas, saludables y eficientes según su clima y su edificio.
books.seo_description: Guía visual de 100 páginas para afrontar el calor en viviendas de España: sombra, ventilación, persianas, toldos, refrigeración, humedad, calima, humo, calidad del aire, consumo energético y decisiones adaptadas al clima.

books.title: Weather, Air Quality and Extreme Heat at Home
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Weather, Air Quality and Extreme Heat at Home is a 100-page visual handbook built around one practical idea: a home is a connected heat-and-air system, not a collection of unrelated devices. The book begins by showing how heat enters, is generated, is stored, moves through materials and air, and eventually must leave. Radiation, conduction, convection, thermal mass, humidity, air movement, hot nights, urban heat islands, and the microclimate outside a particular window are translated into household-scale diagrams so readers can diagnose why a room or dwelling becomes uncomfortable before buying a solution.

The middle of the book turns diagnosis into layered action. It examines window orientation and glass, roofs, walls, insulation, thermal bridges, leakage, room layout, internal heat sources, balconies and top-floor conditions, then develops a shade-first strategy using external shading, interior blinds and curtains, solar-control films, reflective surfaces, trees, cool roofs, and rental-friendly measures. Ventilation is treated as a decision rather than a ritual: cross-ventilation, single-sided ventilation, stack effect, night flushing, fan placement, ceiling fans, evaporative cooling, dehumidification, zone cooling, air-conditioning types and sizing, thermostat strategy, portable units, maintenance, and smart controls are compared according to context.

Heat is only half the indoor-environment problem, so the later pages connect cooling to air quality and energy. The book covers outdoor pollution, PM2.5, wildfire smoke, the trade-off between opening windows for cooling and closing them for cleaner air, air purifiers, clean-air rooms, CO₂ as a ventilation clue, cooking particles and moisture, condensation and mold risk, electricity bills, cooling demand, cost-versus-impact decisions, and power-outage strategies. Illustrative household scenarios—including Mediterranean and humid coastal homes—show how the pieces interact, and the final action planning converts the whole system into a practical 24-hour routine that changes with sun, temperature, humidity, air quality, and household needs.
books.seo_description: A 100-page visual home guide to extreme heat, thermal comfort, shading, ventilation, fans, air conditioning, smoke and PM2.5, indoor air quality, cooling costs, power outages, and practical heat-safe household decisions.

books.title: La segunda riqueza
books.subtitle: Guía práctica para generar ingresos con inteligencia artificial después de los 50
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: La segunda riqueza es una guía práctica para personas con experiencia que quieren convertir criterio, conocimientos, relaciones, reputación y reconocimiento de patrones en servicios, productos y sistemas apoyados por inteligencia artificial. El libro evita las promesas de dinero rápido y empieza por el margen real de tiempo y dinero, la experiencia utilizable, los límites de la IA generativa, la elección de mercado, la privacidad y la necesidad de trabajar con evidencia. Después desarrolla la escucha del mercado, los problemas caros, la selección de camino, el trabajo en plataformas, los servicios empaquetados, las evaluaciones para pequeñas empresas, los activos digitales, las microherramientas, el precio, la prospección, los procedimientos y la automatización posterior a la prueba. La parte de laboratorios obliga a producir objetos reales: una muestra de servicio, edición y ghostwriting, contenido para negocio local, una página de aterrizaje, una evaluación de oportunidades de IA, un producto digital, un motor de contenido o una herramienta de una sola función. El plan final de noventa días convierte el aprendizaje en entrevistas, muestras, pilotos, entregas, pruebas, procedimientos y decisiones basadas en evidencia. Los veinte apéndices reúnen hojas de trabajo, entrevistas, scorecards, ofertas, precios, mensajes, propuestas, controles de privacidad, SOP y paneles de seguimiento.

books.title: FREE IELTS SOS Visual Companion
books.subtitle: 90-Minute Graphic Review for Listening, Reading, Writing & Speaking
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
FREE IELTS SOS Visual Companion is the no-cost visual review companion to the IELTS SOS series. It is designed for the final stretch before the exam, when candidates need fast recall rather than another long course. The book compresses high-priority reminders from Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking into a graphic review format that can be scanned quickly, making it useful beside any IELTS SOS language edition as a final visual refresher.

The companion focuses on the kinds of decisions that are easiest to forget under time pressure: recognizing Listening distractors and answer constraints, protecting Reading time and evidence discipline, recalling the core logic of Academic Writing Task 1 and Writing Task 2, and keeping Speaking responses clear, natural and recoverable. Its purpose is not to replace the full IELTS SOS books, but to turn their last-minute strategy into a compact visual layer built around memory cues, rapid checklists, exam traps, fast fixes and score-saving reminders.

The 90-minute framing is deliberately practical. Candidates can use the companion as a final pass across all four skills or jump directly to the area where they are most likely to lose avoidable marks. It should be treated as a free supplement to the fuller IELTS SOS guides, not as a promise of a particular band score or a substitute for language development, official test information, or full-length preparation.

books.title: IELTS SOS: Do Not Enter the Exam Without This Book
books.subtitle: The Last-Minute Survival Guide to Listening, Reading, Writing & Speaking: Tricks, Fast Fixes, Exam Traps, and Score-Saving Strategies
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
IELTS SOS: Do Not Enter the Exam Without This Book is a last-minute triage manual for candidates who no longer have time for another broad IELTS course. Its mission is to compress high-value, exam-day decisions into one searchable reference covering Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking. Rather than promising miracle phrases, answer-pattern shortcuts, or guaranteed bands, the book focuses on controllable actions: task interpretation, timing, evidence selection, spelling, paragraph control, recovery after mistakes, and clear spoken communication.

The book is organized around fast recognition, action, example, trap, and recovery. It covers computer-delivered test execution, score triage, Listening prediction and distractors, Reading evidence discipline and time management, Academic and General Training Writing tasks, Speaking Parts 1–3, fluency, vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and emergency protocols for the last 24 hours, the final hour, and the final ten minutes. Colour-coded quick wins, exam traps, repair moves, worked examples, micro-checklists, and myths to reject are used to make the advice scannable under time pressure.

A core principle is that last-minute preparation cannot rebuild a language system overnight, but it can stop preventable mark leakage. Candidates are repeatedly encouraged to know their exact module, understand what each section rewards, protect strong sections from avoidable errors, and use only strategies that remain portable across modern computer-delivered testing. The guide is independent and is not endorsed by IELTS, British Council, IDP, or Cambridge; official-format facts are separated from the author's instructional synthesis.
books.seo_description: A last-minute IELTS survival guide for Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking with fast fixes, exam traps, time triage, computer-test strategy, writing and speaking repair, and score-saving checklists.

books.title: Bertahan Hidup dari Gempa Bumi di Indonesia
books.subtitle: Panduan Visual Lengkap 120 Halaman untuk Kesiapsiagaan, Keselamatan, Tsunami & Pemulihan
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Bertahan Hidup dari Gempa Bumi di Indonesia adalah sistem visual 120 langkah yang dirancang khusus untuk realitas kepulauan Indonesia—bukan terjemahan sederhana dari panduan negara lain. Buku ini menghubungkan ilmu gempa, kesiapsiagaan rumah dan keluarga, tindakan saat guncangan, keputusan tsunami, menit dan jam setelah gempa, 72 jam pertama, serta pemulihan awal. Konteksnya mencakup kota padat, desa, masyarakat pesisir, pulau kecil, rumah sederhana, apartemen, sekolah, pasar, sepeda motor, bus, kereta, feri dan pelabuhan ketika unsur tersebut benar-benar memengaruhi keputusan keselamatan.

Bagian awal membangun literasi risiko: sesar, hiposenter, episenter, magnitudo, intensitas, subduksi, gempa susulan, likuefaksi, longsor, paparan, kerentanan, kapasitas dan risiko dijelaskan tanpa mengubah istilah seperti megathrust menjadi ramalan waktu. Bagian persiapan kemudian membawa pembaca ke rumah dan keluarga: mengamankan ruang, menilai bahaya nonstruktural, merencanakan titik temu dan rute, menyiapkan tas siaga, air, makanan, obat, dokumen dan kebutuhan khusus, serta menyimpan inventaris dan informasi penting. Nama dan sistem resmi seperti BMKG, InaTEWS, BNPB, BPBD, InfoBMKG, 112 dan 119 digunakan dengan batasan yang tepat dan kebutuhan verifikasi lokal bila layanan berbeda antardaerah.

Saat guncangan, buku memusatkan perhatian pada perlindungan kepala dan tubuh, menghindari lari massal ke pintu, dan menyesuaikan tindakan dengan rumah, sekolah, tempat kerja, pasar, kendaraan dan transportasi. Karena Indonesia adalah negara kepulauan dengan banyak komunitas pesisir, tsunami mendapat bagian khusus: tanda alam, peringatan resmi, InaTEWS, keputusan untuk bergerak setelah aman dari guncangan, jalur lokal, kemacetan evakuasi, kebutuhan mobilitas, serta pilihan berjalan kaki atau berkendara berdasarkan rencana setempat. Bagian akhir membahas cedera dan bahaya langsung, keputusan keluar atau tetap, orang terjebak dan cara memberi sinyal, komunikasi, informasi resmi, 72 jam pertama, dokumentasi kerusakan, penilaian profesional, bantuan resmi dan pemulihan bertahap. Tujuannya bukan menciptakan kepanikan, melainkan membuat keputusan penting lebih mudah diingat ketika waktu dan perhatian terbatas.
books.seo_description: Panduan visual 120 langkah untuk kesiapsiagaan gempa dan tsunami di Indonesia: risiko regional, rumah dan keluarga, tindakan saat guncangan, BMKG/InaTEWS, evakuasi pantai, 72 jam pertama, dan pemulihan.

learning: Membedakan sesar, hiposenter, episenter, magnitudo, intensitas, bahaya, paparan, kerentanan, kapasitas, dan risiko.
Memahami konteks subduksi dan gempa Indonesia tanpa mengubah istilah megathrust atau pola historis menjadi ramalan waktu.
Mengurangi bahaya nonstruktural di rumah dan mengetahui kapan penilaian struktur membutuhkan tenaga profesional.
Membangun rencana keluarga, titik temu, rute, tas siaga, persediaan air dan makanan, obat, dokumen, serta dukungan kebutuhan khusus.
Melakukan tindakan perlindungan saat guncangan dan menyesuaikannya dengan rumah, sekolah, tempat kerja, pasar, kendaraan, dan ruang publik.
Memahami peran BMKG, InfoBMKG, InaTEWS, BNPB dan BPBD serta memverifikasi layanan darurat lokal seperti 112 bila diperlukan.
Mengenali bahwa tsunami adalah bahaya pesisir bersyarat dan menggabungkan tanda alam, peringatan resmi, serta rute evakuasi lokal.
Membuat keputusan evakuasi pantai tanpa menganggap berjalan kaki atau kendaraan selalu menjadi satu-satunya pilihan yang benar.
Menangani menit dan jam pertama setelah gempa: cedera, kebakaran, gas, kerusakan, gempa susulan, komunikasi, dan orang terjebak.
Menata 72 jam pertama, dokumentasi kerusakan, penilaian profesional, bantuan resmi, dan pemulihan awal secara bertahap.
books.target_audience: Untuk warga dan pengunjung Indonesia; keluarga, penyewa, pemilik rumah, pelajar, pekerja, komuter, masyarakat pesisir, lansia, pengasuh, penyandang disabilitas, dan pelancong antarpulau yang membutuhkan sistem visual untuk bersiap sebelum gempa, bertindak saat guncangan, membuat keputusan tsunami, bertahan pada 72 jam pertama, dan memasuki pemulihan awal.

books.title: Ethik im Zeitalter der Künstlichen Intelligenz
books.subtitle: Menschliche Verantwortung und die neuen Grenzen von Richtig und Falsch auf dem Weg zur Allgemeinen Künstlichen Intelligenz
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Ethik im Zeitalter der Künstlichen Intelligenz behandelt Ethik als praktische Frage danach, was getan werden sollte, wer Verantwortung trägt, welche Rechte geschützt werden müssen, welche Schäden zählen und wie Macht begrenzt werden kann, wenn KI-Systeme immer tiefer in menschliche Entscheidungen eingreifen. Das Buch beginnt bei klassischen Themen wie Täuschung, Diskriminierung, Überwachung und Verantwortung und führt weiter zu synthetischer Identität, kognitiver Privatsphäre, Manipulation, Erklärbarkeit und dem Recht, algorithmische Entscheidungen zu hinterfragen.

Ein zweiter Schwerpunkt liegt auf agentischen Systemen, Abschaltbarkeit, Governance und der Frage, wie menschliche Kontrolle erhalten bleibt, wenn KI selbstständiger handelt. Das Buch macht deutlich, dass verantwortungsvolle Systeme beobachtbar, korrigierbar und stoppbar bleiben müssen und dass technische Möglichkeit nicht automatisch moralische Zulässigkeit bedeutet.

Im letzten Teil richtet sich der Blick auf Künstliche Allgemeine Intelligenz, kollidierende Werte, Maschinenbewusstsein, mögliche Maschinenrechte und die Grenzen dessen, was Menschen niemals vollständig delegieren sollten. Die Darstellung unterscheidet bewusst zwischen gegenwärtigen Fähigkeiten, plausiblen Entwicklungen und Spekulation. Sie orientiert sich an anerkannten internationalen Rahmenwerken und verbindet diese mit einer zugänglichen, menschenzentrierten Argumentation über Autonomie, Würde, Verantwortung und institutionelle Kontrolle.
books.seo_description: Ein praxisnahes Buch über KI-Ethik, Verantwortung, Datenschutz, Diskriminierung, Deepfakes, kognitive Rechte, autonome Agenten, Abschaltbarkeit, Governance, AGI, Maschinenbewusstsein und menschliche Kontrolle.

learning: Verstehen, warum technische Machbarkeit und ethische Zulässigkeit zwei verschiedene Fragen sind.
Verantwortung in komplexen KI-Systemen auf Entwickler, Betreiber, Organisationen und Nutzer differenziert verteilen.
Täuschung, Diskriminierung, Überwachung, Manipulation und synthetische Identität als praktische KI-Ethik-Probleme einordnen.
Kognitive Privatsphäre, Erklärbarkeit, Einwilligung und menschliche Autonomie als zentrale Rechte im KI-Zeitalter verstehen.
Erkennen, warum leistungsfähige KI-Systeme beobachtbar, korrigierbar, reversibel und geordnet abschaltbar bleiben müssen.
Zwischen heutigen KI-Fähigkeiten, plausiblen Entwicklungen und spekulativen AGI-Szenarien unterscheiden.
Debatten über Maschinenbewusstsein und mögliche Maschinenrechte prüfen, ohne bestehende Menschenrechte und Pflichten aus dem Blick zu verlieren.
Internationale Governance-Rahmenwerke als Orientierung nutzen, ohne ethisches Urteil durch bloße Compliance zu ersetzen.
books.target_audience: Für Studierende, Lehrende, Entwickler, Forschende, Führungskräfte, Unternehmer, politische Entscheidungsträger, Technologieprofis und allgemein interessierte Leser, die einen zugänglichen, aber differenzierten Rahmen für die ethischen Folgen künstlicher Intelligenz suchen.

books.title: Akıllı İnsanlar Neden Parayla İlgili Kötü Kararlar Verir?
books.subtitle: Kazanmanın, Harcamanın, Biriktirmenin, Risk Almanın ve Servet Oluşturmanın Gizli Psikolojisi
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Akıllı İnsanlar Neden Parayla İlgili Kötü Kararlar Verir?, doğru finansal kararı bilmek ile onu gerçek hayatta uygulamak arasındaki boşluğu inceler. Zekânın; aileden devralınan para kurallarına, kimlik baskısına, korkuya, statü arzusuna, ruh hâline, alışkanlıklara, bugünü geleceğe tercih etme eğilimine ve belirsizliğe karşı bağışıklık sağlamadığını gösterir. İlk para derslerinden ve kimsenin yazmadığı aile defterinden başlayarak duygusal harcamaya, cüzdandaki seyirciye, daha fazlanın normalleşmesine, gelecekteki benliğe, görünmeyen alternatife, otomasyona ve iradeye ihtiyaç duymadan önce verilen kararlara ilerler. Daha sonra beceri, kanıt, güven ve kaldıraç üzerinden daha fazla kazanmanın psikolojisini; borç, risk ve dayanıklılığı ele alır. Son bölümler serveti seçenekler, hayır diyebilme hakkı ve yeter sınırıyla ilişkilendirir; okur defteri somut deneyler sunar.
books.seo_description: Miras alınan para inançları, duygusal harcama, statü, gelecek benliği, gelir, borç, risk, finansal özgürlük ve daha iyi para kararları üzerine uygulamalı psikoloji rehberi.

books.title: Bırak Gitsin, Ama Sen Kendinden Gitme
books.subtitle: Kalmayı Seçmeyen Birinden Kendi Varlığını Terk Etmeden Nasıl Geçilir
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Bırak Gitsinler, Ama Sen Kendinden Gitme; bir insanın, işin, dostluğun, şehrin, rolün ya da hayalin gidişinden sonra kişinin kendi hayatından da uzaklaşmamasını anlatır. Kitap gidenleri düşmanlaştırmaz; okuru bedenine, onuruna, zamanına, uykusuna, işine ve geleceğine geri çağırır. Yirmi bir bölüm boyunca vedasız gidişler, açıklama ihtiyacı, tutunma, sessizce yalvarma, boş yeri taşıma, bedene dönüş, hayatı bekleme modundan çıkarma, boş alanla kalma, yarayı tahta oturtmama, acıya ihanet etmeden neşeye izin verme ve giden kişiyi yeniden gerçek ölçüsüne indirme üzerinde durur. Ana fikir, başkasının gidişini yönetmeye çalışmak yerine kendi varlığını terk etmemektir.

learning: Bir gidişin resmi bir vedadan önce davranışlarda nasıl görünür hâle geldiğini fark etmek.
Giden kişinin seçimini kendi değerinin nihai hükmü hâline getirmemek.
Cevapsız soruları sonsuz bir iç mahkemeye dönüştürmeden gerçekle kalabilmek.
Beden, uyku, iş, para, arkadaşlık ve günlük düzen üzerinden kendi hayatına geri dönmek.
Boşluğu ve acıyı inkâr etmeden onların hayatın tamamını yönetmesine izin vermemek.
Öfke ya da küçümseme yerine küçük ve görünür özsadakatlerle geleceği yeniden kurmak.
books.target_audience: Ayrılık, uzaklaşan bir dostluk, biten bir iş, taşınma, kapanan bir rol ya da yarım kalan bir gelecek sonrasında kendine geri dönmek isteyen okurlar için.

books.title: Servet, Kendini Ucuza Satmayı Bıraktığın Yerde Başlar
books.subtitle: Zamanını, Yeteneğini, Varlığını ve Hayatını Değerinin Altında Vermeyi Bırakmak
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Servet, Kendini Ucuza Satmayı Bıraktığın Yerde Başlar, serveti yalnızca para olarak değil; zaman, yetenek, dikkat, beden, sınır ve yaşam alanı olarak ele alır. Kitap kişinin kendini yalnız düşük ücret kabul ettiğinde değil, yorgunken sürekli erişilebilir olduğunda, fazla açıklama yaptığında, kapsamı belirsiz tuttuğunda, müşteriyi kaybetme korkusuyla pazarlık yapamadığında, görünür olmaktan korktuğu için yeteneğini sakladığında veya ilişkide kendini sildiğinde de ucuza verebildiğini gösterir. Çıraklık ile aşağılanmayı, etik değer ile gösterişli fiyatı, beceri ile kanıtı birbirinden ayırır. Son bölümler dikkat ekonomisini, piyasa paniğini, nefret etmeden ayrılmayı ve otuz günlük yeniden fiyatlandırma planını işler: sızıntıları gözlemek, bir sınırı korumak, bir beceri kanıtını güçlendirmek ve daha temiz bir alışveriş yapmak.
books.seo_description: Özdeğer, ücret, sınırlar, beceri, kanıt, dikkat, ilişkiler, etik değer ve zamanı ile varlığını ucuza vermeyi bırakmak için 30 günlük uygulama planı.

Zamanını, Yeteneğini, Varlığını ve Hayatını Değerinin Altında Vermeyi Bırakmak

learning: Zamanı, yeteneği, dikkati, bedeni ve varlığı ucuza vermenin finans dışı biçimlerini fark etmek.
Sağlıklı çıraklık ile kronik değersizleştirmeyi ayırmak.
Korkuya dayalı erişilebilirlik yerine kapsam, sınır ve şartları netleştirmek.
Daha yüksek ücretleri beceri, kanıt, referans ve anlaşılır değerle desteklemek.
Panik ve müşteriyi kaybetme korkusunun pazarlık davranışını nasıl zayıflattığını görmek.
Özdeğer mantığını ilişkilerde sertleşmeden uygulamak.
Dikkat ve enerjiyi sınırlı varlıklar olarak korumak.
Otuz günlük planla değeri teori olmaktan çıkarıp gözlenebilir davranışa dönüştürmek.
books.target_audience: İşini düşük fiyatlayan, zamanını veya duygusal emeğini fazla veren, sınır koymakta zorlanan ya da kişisel değerle daha temiz ve kanıta dayalı bir ilişki kurmak isteyen serbest çalışanlar, profesyoneller, yaratıcılar ve genel okurlar için.

books.title: Esaretsiz Zeka
books.subtitle: Yetenekli Zihni Düşük Kapasiteli Odaların Esaretinden Korumak
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Esaretsiz Zeka, yüksek bilişsel ve duygusal kapasitenin yanlış insanlara, ilişkilere, rollere ve ortamlara erken teslim edilmesini inceleyen düşünsel bir kişisel gelişim kitabıdır. Metin kapasite ile insan değerini özellikle birbirinden ayırır; amacı insanları sıralamak değil, derinlik, güven, yaratıcılık, dikkat ve erişimin nerede güvenle tutulabileceğini göstermektir. Kitap çok erken açılan zihin, hızın kendini güvenlik sanması, her şeyi açıklama tuzağı ve hak edilmemiş erişim gibi sorunlarla başlar.

On iki bölüm boyunca eser; güvenin yavaş kurulması, üretimin onay arayışından ayrılması, zekâya bir misyon verilmesi, çökmeden yalnız kalmak, eşitsiz kapasiteyi nefretsiz görmek, duygusal zekâ, bağlanma, sinir sistemi, sessiz çıkış, profesyonel sınırlar, rol netliği ve omurgalı yumuşaklık üzerinde ilerler. Son bölümde özgür zihin, gücünü herkese dağıtan zihin değil, anahtarın kimde kalacağını bilen zihin olarak tanımlanır. Amaç sertleşmek değil; derinliği korurken insanlığını, şefkatini ve yaratıcı gücünü kiraya vermemektir.
books.seo_description: Yüksek kapasiteli ve yetenekli zihinler için erişim, güven, sınırlar, misyon, yalnızlık, duygusal zekâ, profesyonel netlik ve kendini silmeden özgür kalma üzerine bir rehber.

books.title: Machine Learning Interviews, Visually Explained
books.subtitle: 250 Questions, Algorithms, Whiteboard Diagrams, Math Intuition, and Real-World ML Systems
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Machine Learning Interviews, Visually Explained is built around 250 interview questions arranged as a learning path rather than a trivia bank. It starts with probability, linear algebra, data discipline, and classical machine-learning foundations; then moves through evaluation, feature engineering, time-series methods, recommendation and ranking, neural networks, attention and transformers, and finally production ML, serving, drift, monitoring, and system-level interview reasoning.

The book is designed to bridge the gap between recognizing a definition and being able to explain a mechanism under interview pressure. Each topic emphasizes assumptions, objectives, geometry or information flow, failure modes, validation choices, and the practical consequences of getting those choices wrong. Short interview-ready answers are paired with deeper conceptual explanations, concrete checks, common mistakes, and whiteboard-oriented reasoning.

Visual explanation is central to the book's teaching method. Diagrams and infographic-style explanations are used where geometry, algorithm steps, information flow, model behavior, or failure modes are easier to understand visually. The goal is not to memorize 250 canned answers, but to learn how to reconstruct an answer from first principles: define the problem, identify the assumption, explain the mechanism, choose the right metric, and recognize how the system can fail.
books.seo_description: A visual, interview-focused machine-learning guide with 250 questions covering ML foundations, algorithms, math intuition, model evaluation, feature engineering, deep learning, recommendation, time series, production ML and real-world system reasoning.

books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Antes de que tu mente le ponga nombre presenta el mindfulness como la capacidad de ver el espacio entre un hecho y la historia que la mente construye sobre él, no como una obligación de sentirse tranquilo. El libro explora cuerpo, memoria, ansiedad, ira, vergüenza, duelo, incertidumbre, silencio, mensajes, notificaciones, aburrimiento y distracción. books.title: Unenslaved Intelligence
books.subtitle: Guarding the Gifted Mind from Capture by Low-Capacity Rooms
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Unenslaved Intelligence is a reflective guide to protecting unusual cognitive and emotional capacity from being consumed by environments, relationships, roles, and expectations that cannot hold it responsibly. The book is careful not to confuse capacity with human worth: its concern is not ranking people, but deciding where depth, attention, trust, creativity, and access can be placed safely. It begins with the gifted mind's tendency to open too early, explain too much, mistake speed for safety, and pour disproportionate energy into people or rooms that have not earned that access.

Across twelve chapters, the book develops a practical philosophy of earned access, disciplined creation, mission, solitude, unequal capacity without contempt, emotional intelligence, quiet exit, professional boundaries, tenderness with structure, and ownership of one's inner life. It argues that intelligence without custody can amplify pain as quickly as insight, and that freedom requires more than raw ability: it requires direction, boundaries, emotional maturity, role clarity, and a life that cannot be rented by every admirer, client, hope, mood, or relationship. The ending returns the key to the reader: depth can remain generous without becoming available to everyone.
books.seo_description: A reflective guide to protecting gifted and high-capacity minds through earned access, boundaries, mission, emotional intelligence, solitude, professional clarity and freedom from self-erasure.

books.title: Let Them Leave, But Do Not Leave Yourself
books.subtitle: How to Move Beyond Someone Who Is Not Willing to Stay Without Abandoning Who You Are
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Let Them Leave, But Do Not Leave Yourself is a literary and practical guide to what remains after a person, role, job, friendship, home, dream, or old identity leaves. Its concern is not condemning departure but preventing the person left behind from disappearing from their own body, work, sleep, self-respect, calendar, and future. Across twenty-one chapters, the book moves through ambiguous endings, the mind’s demand for explanations, holding on, silent begging, the empty place, returning to the body, leaving waiting mode, making room for emptiness, refusing to build an identity around the wound, allowing joy back in, and letting the absent become ordinary again. The central discipline is simple: let departure be real without granting it final authority over the life that remains.
books.seo_description: A practical and literary guide to grief, ambiguous endings, self-respect, body, waiting, closure, boundaries, joy, and rebuilding life after someone or something leaves.

books.title: Die Ratenfalle
books.subtitle: Wenn wir das Morgen für heute ausgeben — Wie kleine Monatszahlungen zukünftige Freiheit binden – und wie man klüger entscheidet
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Die Ratenfalle macht eine besonders wirksame Illusion der Alltagsfinanzen sichtbar: Eine kleine Monatsrate wirkt wie eine kleine Entscheidung, obwohl sie Einkommen und Handlungsspielraum vieler zukünftiger Monate binden kann. Das Buch ist weder kreditfeindlich noch konsumfeindlich. Es zeigt, dass Raten vernünftig sein können, wenn sie Liquidität schützen, eine notwendige Anschaffung ermöglichen oder einen echten zeitlichen Engpass überbrücken. Entscheidend ist jedoch, ob nach Gesamtpreis, Laufzeit, laufenden Kosten, Einkommenssicherheit und möglichen Rückschlägen noch genügend finanzieller Spielraum bleibt.

In dreißig Kapiteln wird die Entscheidung systematisch auseinandergebaut. Das Buch erklärt, wie aus ‘Ich habe das Geld nicht’ unmerklich ‘49 Euro im Monat passen noch hinein’ wird, warum zukünftiges Einkommen noch nicht frei verfügbares Geld ist, weshalb ‘nur X Euro im Monat’ den Blick verengt und warum null Prozent Finanzierung nicht automatisch null Kosten bedeutet. Es trennt Kreditgenehmigung von persönlicher Tragfähigkeit und zeigt, wie mehrere kleine Raten gemeinsam eine große Wand bilden können. Einkommensrückgang, steigende Lebenshaltungskosten, unregelmäßige Ausgaben, Notgroschen, Wertverlust, Restschuld, Wiederverkauf und die Möglichkeit eines erzwungenen Verkaufs werden als Teile derselben Entscheidung behandelt.

Die späteren Kapitel erweitern den Blick um Statuskonsum, FOMO, Optimismus über die eigene Zukunft, Alternativen vor der Finanzierung, Schuldenübersicht, neue Schulden zur Rettung alter Schulden, Behalten-oder-Verkaufen-Entscheidungen, Belastungen in Beziehungen und die Frage, wann Raten tatsächlich vernünftig sein können. Die deutsche Ausgabe wurde für natürlichen deutschen Lesefluss und eigenständige Alltagssituationen formuliert. Ihr Ziel ist keine Angst-Rhetorik, sondern Präzision: Gesamtbelastung sichtbar machen, mehrere Zukunftsszenarien prüfen, die Exit-Tür vor dem Kauf mitdenken und finanzielle Freiheit als den Teil des zukünftigen Einkommens verstehen, über den noch nicht im Voraus verfügt wurde.
books.seo_description: Ein praktischer Finanzratgeber zu Ratenkauf, BNPL, Gesamtkosten, Tragfähigkeit, zukünftigem Einkommen, Notgroschen, Wertverlust, Schuldenstapelung, FOMO und finanzieller Bewegungsfreiheit.

books.title: Taksit Tuzağı
books.subtitle: Yarını Bugünden Harcadığımızda — Kolay Aylık Ödemelerin Geleceğinizi Sessizce İpotek Etmesi
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Taksit Tuzağı, günlük tüketici finansının en güçlü yanılsamalarından birini görünür hâle getirir: aylık ödemenin küçük görünmesinin, kararın da küçük olduğu anlamına gelmesi. Kitap ‘taksit kötüdür’ diyen bir yaklaşım kurmaz. Taksidin bazı durumlarda nakit akışını koruyabileceğini, zorunlu bir ihtiyacı zamanında karşılayabileceğini veya maliyeti öngörülebilir bir döneme yayabileceğini kabul eder. Asıl mesele, aracın ne zaman tuzağa dönüştüğünü anlamaktır. Bunun için reklam dilinden çok toplam maliyet, gelir güvenilirliği, bütçedeki gerçek boşluk, acil durum kapasitesi, sözleşmeden çıkış yolu ve satın alma sonrasında kalan hareket özgürlüğü incelenir.

Otuz bölüm boyunca kitap, ‘Param yok’ cümlesinin nasıl ‘Taksitle alırım’a dönüştüğünü; gelecek gelirin neden henüz bugünün parası olmadığını; ‘ayda sadece...’ ifadesinin toplam bedeli zihinde nasıl küçülttüğünü; sıfır faizin neden her zaman sıfır maliyet anlamına gelmediğini ve kredi onayının gerçek ödeme gücüyle neden aynı şey olmadığını örneklerle açıklar. Birkaç küçük taksidin tek bir büyük duvara dönüşmesi, gelirin düşmesi, hayat pahalılığının artması, satın alma gününde görünmeyen masraflar, acil durum fonunun erimesi, ürünün değer kaybı, ikinci el piyasası, borç devam ederken ürünü satma zorunluluğu ve heyecanın taksitlerden önce bitmesi gibi gerçek hayat senaryoları kararın görünmeyen tarafını ortaya çıkarır.

Kitabın ilerleyen bölümleri statü için tüketim, FOMO, iyimser gelecek varsayımları, kredi limiti, beklemenin ekonomik değeri, ikinci el seçenekleri, tamir mi değiştirme mi sorusu, üç gelecek testi, sözleşmeyi rakamlarla okuma, borç haritası çıkarma, eski borcu yeni borçla kurtarma, aile içindeki finansal gerilim ve taksidin hangi koşullarda gerçekten mantıklı olabileceği üzerinde durur. Amaç tüketimden korkutmak değil, kararın direksiyonunu yeniden okuyucuya vermektir. Kitabın temel ölçütü şudur: iyi bir finansman kararı yalnızca bu ay ödenebilen değil, kötü bir ay geldiğinde de hayatın manevra alanını tamamen ortadan kaldırmayan karardır.

books.title: The Installment Trap
books.subtitle: When You Spend Tomorrow Today — How Easy Monthly Payments Can Quietly Mortgage Your Future
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
The Installment Trap examines one of the most persuasive illusions in everyday consumer finance: the idea that a small monthly payment must represent a small financial decision. The book does not argue that all installment credit is bad. It shows how financing can sometimes protect liquidity, bridge a timing mismatch or make a necessary purchase possible, while also explaining why the same tool can become dangerous when a buyer looks only at the payment and not at total cost, future obligations, household margin, income reliability and exit options. Its central question is not simply, ‘Can I make this payment this month?’ but ‘How much future freedom remains if life does not unfold exactly as expected?’

Across thirty chapters, the book follows the entire life cycle of an installment decision. It explains how ‘I do not have the money’ can quietly become ‘I can afford the monthly payment’; why future income is not yet free money; how the phrase ‘only X per month’ shrinks attention; why zero interest does not automatically mean zero cost; and why lender approval is not the same as personal affordability. It then looks at the cumulative effect of several small obligations, due-date collisions, falling income, rising living costs, irregular expenses, emergency funds, depreciation, negative equity, forced resale and the uncomfortable possibility of still paying for something whose usefulness or excitement has already disappeared.

The later chapters move from diagnosis to decision-making. They examine status spending, self-proof, FOMO, optimistic assumptions about future income, alternatives to financing, debt mapping, rescuing old debt with new debt, keep-or-sell decisions, financial flexibility and the effect of installment pressure on relationships. Practical examples repeatedly reconstruct the full decision by putting total cost, term length, fees, residual monthly margin, downside scenarios and exit routes back on the page. The result is a financial-literacy guide about preserving choice. It is designed to help readers tell the difference between credit that serves a plan and credit that quietly turns future income into a calendar of promises.
books.seo_description: A practical personal-finance guide to installment payments, BNPL, total cost, affordability, future income, emergency funds, depreciation, debt stacking, FOMO, exit planning and financial flexibility.

books.title: When Money Runs Short
books.subtitle: How to change the cost of food, housing, healthcare, transport, and everyday life when finances are tight—without damaging what matters most
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: When Money Runs Short is a practical decision guide for periods when income no longer covers the real cost of living and small frugality tips are not enough. It distinguishes three levels of response—saving, substitution, and changing the model of daily life—then applies them to food, housing, transport, healthcare, clothing, education, family life, debt, savings, and recovery. The book asks readers to separate needs from the expensive ways those needs are currently met, rank expenses by the harm caused if they disappear, protect a realistic dignity floor, and examine large structural costs before exhausting themselves over tiny purchases. Its workbook turns the framework into concrete tools for mapping the monthly shortfall, comparing the real cost of a car or home, calculating cost per meal and cost per use, reviewing automatic payments, mapping debt, defining emergency-reserve rules, and testing non-essential expenses through a thirty-day absence experiment.

books.title: Why Smart People Make Bad Money Decisions
books.subtitle: The Hidden Psychology of Earning, Spending, Saving, Risk, and Building Wealth
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Why Smart People Make Bad Money Decisions examines the gap between knowing what is financially sensible and actually doing it. Intelligence does not make a person immune to inherited money rules, family history, identity, fear, status pressure, mood, habit, present bias, uncertainty, or the social meaning attached to spending. The book moves from early money lessons and the unwritten family ledger into emotional and status-sensitive purchases, lifestyle normalization, the conflict between present and future selves, opportunity cost, automation, earning power, marketable skills, confidence built from evidence, leverage, debt, risk, and the need to build a life that can survive being wrong. The final sections widen wealth beyond accumulation to relationships, financial buffers, the ability to say no, and a personal boundary for enough. A reader's notebook supplies twelve practical experiments and a decision lab uses hypothetical cases to make the psychological mechanisms visible.
books.seo_description: A practical behavioral-finance guide to inherited money rules, spending psychology, status, future-self decisions, earning power, debt, risk, financial freedom, and better money habits.

books.title: Do the Thing
books.subtitle: Why Preparation Feels Like Progress—and How to Finally Act
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary: Do the Thing studies the distance between preparing for a life and changing it through action. It begins with respectable forms of delay: cleaner systems, more research, better tools, improved plans, public intentions, and endless readiness. It distinguishes support work from state-changing work and follows the psychology of almost through undefined goals, fear of exposure, identity built around delay, and the comfort of remaining in potential rather than contacting reality. Action is treated as the mechanism that produces feedback, reduces ambiguity, rewrites identity, and teaches the body that beginning can be survived. The middle sections develop an action psychology built around starting before certainty, finishing small things, letting clarity emerge after movement, treating motivation as a result, and using repeatable wins. The later action system becomes concrete: define one real next step, design the first ten minutes, remove friction, use cues and calendars, create bounded time containers, finish open loops, handle emotionally difficult tasks, recover quickly after interruption, and collect evidence instead of hype. The long game closes on private progress, resistance from others, self-respect through kept commitments, and a life built by what was actually done.
books.seo_description: A practical action guide to procrastination disguised as preparation, fear of exposure, starting before certainty, small completions, friction design, time containers, recovery, evidence, and self-trust.

books.title: Balanced Price Range Trading
books.subtitle: BPR, Opposing Fair Value Gaps, Equilibrium, and Smart Money Entry Zones
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
Balanced Price Range Trading treats BPR as a measurable overlap between two opposing Fair Value Gaps rather than as a mystical institutional signal. The book separates observation, interpretation, and trading decision: first define the two imbalance intervals and their intersection, then establish the BPR boundaries and Consequent Encroachment midpoint, and only after that evaluate whether context justifies an entry, an invalidation level, an objective, or no trade at all. Historical OHLC examples are used to make the geometry reproducible, and failed examples remain part of the framework rather than being edited out after the fact.

The middle sections build the concept from formation sequence and bullish or bearish anatomy through narrow and wide ranges, fresh versus tested or mitigated BPRs, nested structures, and location inside a dealing range. Premium, discount, equilibrium, liquidity, market structure, and higher-timeframe versus lower-timeframe alignment are treated as context that can change the meaning of the same measured zone. Execution chapters then examine returns to the BPR, midpoint entries, confirmation inside the range, confluence with Fair Value Gaps, Order Blocks, Breakers and inversion structures, and the practical relationship between entry, invalidation, objective, risk, and the decision to stand aside.

The final sections make failure and research part of the model. Readers learn to classify failed BPRs, identify common analytical mistakes, convert visual ideas into testable rules, build a BPR dataset, backtest without hindsight, evaluate metrics beyond win rate, and create a personal playbook. Ten outcome-aware case studies, a visual BPR atlas, a dataset schema, glossary, and visual-reference material turn the book into both a conceptual guide and a repeatable research workflow.
books.seo_description: A rigorous guide to Balanced Price Range trading covering opposing Fair Value Gap overlap, CE midpoint, premium/discount, equilibrium, liquidity, market structure, entries, invalidation, failure and backtesting.

Breakout & Retest Trading organizes the strategy into a fixed chain: context, level, break, acceptance, retest, trigger, invalidation, target space, risk and execution. books.title: CHoCH & BOS

books.summary:
CHoCH & BOS: Reading Market Structure Shifts turns two heavily used trading labels into observable, testable structural events. Rather than calling every opposite candle a Change of Character or every broken high a Break of Structure, the book begins with swing selection, pivot stability, candidate versus confirmed pivots, structural hierarchy, protected references, and the prior state that a continuation break is supposed to continue.

The book treats CHoCH as a meaningful structural violation that can move the market into transition without guaranteeing an immediate reversal, while BOS is evaluated against an already defined directional state. Context is allowed to filter a decision but not rewrite whether an event occurred after the outcome is known. Invalidation comes before targets, entry trigger is separated from entry location, failed events remain in the journal, and no-trade is treated as a legitimate system decision rather than an absence of analysis.

books.title: CVD TRADING
books.subtitle: Reading Cumulative Volume Delta, Order Flow, Absorption, Divergence, and Liquidity
books.author: Faramarz Kowsari
books.summary:
CVD TRADING treats Cumulative Volume Delta as evidence about classified aggressive execution, not as a stand-alone prediction line. The book begins with the mechanics behind the indicator: volume versus delta, how trades are classified, how a cumulative curve is built, why session resets and anchors matter, and why two platforms can show different CVD histories. Price and CVD are then read together so the reader can distinguish confirmation from disagreement and ask the more useful question: what happened to price when aggressive buying or selling actually appeared?

The central chapters develop the order-flow relationships that make CVD valuable in context. They cover effort versus result, confirmation, divergence, absorption, exhaustion, aggression efficiency, failed auctions, market structure, liquidity, support and resistance, balance and range behavior, VWAP, Volume Profile, footprint charts and DOM. Trend continuation, reversals, breakouts, failed breakouts, trapped traders, session opens, anchoring, re-synchronization and multi-horizon CVD are treated as conditional structures rather than automatic signals. Separate sections address futures, crypto, stocks, FX and CFDs, including the important limits created by data provenance, tick reconstruction, aggregation and platform methodology.

The later part of the book turns interpretation into a testable process. It examines failure modes, backtesting, measurement, case studies in bullish and bearish absorption, successful and failed divergence, range absorption, crypto spot-versus-perpetual differences and trapped aggression. The final playbook chapters place context ahead of signal: market and session first, then structure and location, then volatility and liquidity, then CVD evidence, and only after that execution. Risk, invalidation, slippage and data quality remain independent of confidence in the indicator. The goal is to move from watching a line to reading an auction with CVD as one disciplined layer of evidence.
books.seo_description: A practical CVD trading guide to cumulative volume delta, order flow, absorption, divergence, liquidity, market structure, data quality, backtesting, risk and playbook design.
